name: BRIDGE
description: BRIDGE is a comprehensive multilingual benchmark designed to evaluate large language models on real-world clinical practice text. It includes 87 tasks across nine languages, covering eight major task types and 14 clinical specialties, spanning the entire continuum of patient care and multiple clinical stages.
reputation: Serves as a foundational resource and unique reference for evaluating LLMs in real-world clinical text understanding; includes a public leaderboard.
notes: Focuses on real-world clinical data rather than exam-style or PubMed text; covers multiple languages and clinical specialties.
